ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white across the central lobe regions to 25% low-intensity black concentrated at the perimeter and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity border along the trailing edge; dense clusters of vertical high-contrast linear streaks on the lateral distal tips; a singular narrow vertical dark streak originating from the median notch vertex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 12% into the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels; presence of several deeper macro-indents (valleys) along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature extending from the central notch to the pointed lateral tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly distinct, vertically aligned parallel rake marks (dark pixel streaks) localized on the outer 15% of both the left and right lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular erosion and jagged jaggedness of the trailing edge tips, suggesting historic physical trauma or significant environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark 'drip' or streak extending vertically from the center of the median notch toward the fluke base.
